scope: Software/audio/render qualification and S3 design comparison; optical/electrical and extended loaded-product qualification are separate.

requirements.meaning: Music causes meaningful fresh state; do not mistake retained state or manual performance for analysis.
requirements.boundary: audio producer -> acquired render snapshot -> final frame
requirements.pass_rule: Known tone/onset/beat fixtures compare actual code with independent input truth; actual music results report lock/beat failures explicitly.

requirements.meaning: Authored palettes and colour clarity survive the output chain.
requirements.pass_rule: Channel arithmetic matches independent vectors including zero, near-black and maximum; forbidden rainbow defaults absent; output preserves intended per-edge parameters.

requirements.meaning: Two independently playable edges and faithful persistence.
requirements.boundary: production command -> state -> both output buffers -> save/reboot
requirements.pass_rule: Changing edgeA leaves edgeB unchanged and vice versa under deterministic input; saved composition recovers without replaying setup commands.

requirements.meaning: Preserve each existing effect identity and centre-referenced geometry.
requirements.boundary: actual supported dispatch modes -> rendered pixels over time
requirements.pass_rule: Enumerate current enabled modes; compare to their specified mapping/motion. No silent disable, new linear sweep, or replacement with a common generic effect.

requirements.meaning: Smooth movement, musical persistence and honest silence.
requirements.pass_rule: Matched output captures expose discontinuity, unintended brightness modulation, hard-black loss and silence/return behaviour; distinguish diagnostics from natural musical quiet. No invented global appeal score.

requirements.meaning: Fit the S3 without sacrificing output.
requirements.boundary: actual target timings and output parity
requirements.pass_rule: Per-effect ceiling 2000us; frame-start cadence follows tests/fixtures/scheduling_gate0/g0r_selection/contract.json vp_contract.admission (p99, arithmetic mean, consecutive misses and recovery), not a hard maximum gap; audio service p99<=8000us; preserve meaning/pixels or justify intended repair.

requirements.meaning: Instrumentation and scorers can detect their claimed failures.
requirements.pass_rule: Reject changed pixels, wrong clock/source/generation, corrupted/partial captures and invalid counters. Software PASS alone cannot certify optical output or musical appeal.

requirements.meaning: Keep the supported performance controls and product feature set.
requirements.boundary: source dispatch/dependencies and exercised command path
requirements.pass_rule: No render heap/blocking I/O, no feature removal, no unsolicited radio-mode changes; changed implementation must preserve enabled modes and relevant control transactions.

comparison_policy: Use actual accepted Waveform lineage as design reference; historical pending-viewing prototypes are not accepted reference light shows. Performance-only optimisations use the frozen pre-change baseline on identical fixed input and the RGB8 tolerance below; corrections require separate targeted independent expected results.

spectral_arithmetic.method: Actual deployed coefficient/window recurrence against independent complex DFT on identical integer PCM; derived rounding bounds per bin.
spectral_arithmetic.required: All71Nyquist-safe bins within their derived bounds;9unsafe slots zero; zeroedstrongtone and +1Nyquist mutations rejected.

onset_return.method: Actual producer and captured real spectra, declared exact-zero boundary, continuous-programme counterfactual.
onset_return.required: No boundary-created attack or threshold poisoning; subsequent controlled attack detected at specified causal hop; steady spectra/quiet emit no events; continuous programme unchanged.

tempo_lock.required: Unchanged BPM, untouched held-out acceptance once entry clears; report every input/error. Neither confidence nor correct tempo alone establishes beat position.

beat_position.method: Preregistered independent beat annotations; actual published ticks at sample hop-end times; no fitted phase offset.
beat_position.required: Report fixed-tolerance precision/recall and signed timing error, including missing and false ticks. Zero ticks cannot pass a phase qualification. BPM-only scoring is insufficient.

harmonic_and_energy.required: Separate numerical band/chroma/triad conformance from real-audio recognition and calibrated loudness; root-dominant synthetic triads cannot establish general chord accuracy. Retain flat/unison failures.

latency_definition.audio_service: Correctly bounded AP work span; p99<=8000us is a service budget, not an audio-to-light measurement.
latency_definition.end_to_end: Sub8ms requirement concerns acquisition-to-emission delivery. Firmware timestamps must identify sample-age assumptions and show submission; physical LED/protocol/optical delay needs separate measurement. Do not substitute service timing for this gate.

performance_output_tolerance.format: RGB8 (8-bit red, green and blue channels)
performance_output_tolerance.baseline: Frozen pre-change build on the same fixed input bytes; record baseline SHA-256; never regenerate expectation from the changed build.
performance_output_tolerance.native16_projection: When comparing preserved native16 replay output, use existing tools/esp_emulator/player.py proj: round(c16 * 255 / 65535). Report this as a display projection, not measured hardware RGB8 output.
performance_output_tolerance.corrections: Require a separate independent expected result.
